steps.text: Good idea! What's the date today?

steps.speaker: Deniz
steps.text: It's the twentieth. Saturday is the twenty-third.

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: Mom finishes work at six. Let's start at seven.
steps.translation: Annem işi altıda bitiriyor. Saat yedide başlayalım.

steps.speaker: Deniz
steps.text: OK. I can come at half past five and help.
steps.translation: Tamam. Beş buçukta gelip yardım edebilirim.

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: Kerem, don't tell Mom!

steps.speaker: Kerem
steps.text: Tell her what? I don't know anything!
steps.translation: Neyi? Ben hiçbir şey bilmiyorum ki!

steps.speaker: Deniz
steps.text: Ha ha! Perfect, Kerem.

nodes.title: Antalya'dan kartpostal
nodes.description: Elif tatilde Sam ve Mia’ya kartpostal yazıyor

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: Mom, can I buy a postcard for Sam?
steps.translation: Anne, Sam için bir kartpostal alabilir miyim?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Of course. Look, there's a shop opposite the hotel.
steps.translation: Tabii. Bak, otelin karşısında bir dükkân var.

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: This postcard has a castle and a boat on it.
steps.translation: Bu kartpostalda bir kale ve bir tekne var.

steps.speaker: Kerem
steps.text: The castle is near our hotel!

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: Dear Sam, we are in Antalya. The sea is beautiful.
steps.translation: Sevgili Sam, Antalya'dayız. Deniz çok güzel.

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: The sun is hot and the beach is very busy.
steps.translation: Güneş sıcak, plaj da çok kalabalık.

steps.speaker: Kerem
steps.text: Write about the boat trip, too!

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: Tomorrow we take a boat to an island.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Don't forget a souvenir for Sam and Mia.
steps.translation: Sam ve Mia için hediyelik eşyayı unutma.

steps.speaker: Elif
steps.text: I have two small boats for them. They're blue!
steps.translation: Onlar için iki küçük tekne aldım. Mavi renkteler!
